name: Rito
source:
A gentle and kind-hearted half-beast whose appaearance resembles a large dog. He is in charge of cooking and serving the customers at Norn's Dine, always wearing a smile and serving as a cheerful mood-maker.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3664240/Norns_Dine/]Steam[/url]]
